skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts of culture, cultural diversity, and their impact on global business environments.
Effectively communicate and negotiate in multicultural settings.
Identify and resolve conflicts arising from cultural differences.
Demonstrate adaptability and confidence in multicultural work environments.
Apply leadership theories in multicultural contexts.
Understand the influence of culture on organizational structure and management in multicultural businesses.
Understand and apply theories of motivation in multicultural settings.
